entities.summary: Jane Pauline Philpott is a physician, academic administrator, and former Canadian politician who represented the riding of Markham—Stouffville in the House of Commons. She was first elected in the 2015 federal election as a member of the Liberal Party and was appointed to the Cabinet of the 29th Canadian Ministry, headed by Justin Trudeau, on November 4, 2015. On March 4, 2019, she resigned from her cabinet position as President of the Treasury Board over the SNC-Lavalin affair. On April 2, 2019, she and Jody Wilson-Raybould were expelled from the Liberal caucus in the aftermath of the controversy.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a member of Justin Trudeau's cabinet, Philpott played a key role in the SNC-Lavalin affair, which led to her expulsion from the Liberal caucus and the eventual resignation of Jody Wilson-Raybould. This controversy had significant implications for Canadian politics and the country's justice system.
